BatteryPulse anonymous version count

Every BatteryPulse release from 0.7.0 attaches this file. Once per version, at
least a day after you start using it, BatteryPulse's automatic update check
downloads it from that version's release and ignores it. GitHub's public
download count of this file then shows how many Macs use each version.

Nothing else is sent: no identifier, no cookie, and nothing about your Mac, its
battery or your settings. GitHub sees your IP address and the app's version, as
it does for the update check.

To turn the count off, open BatteryPulse's Settings > General and turn off
"Include this Mac in the anonymous version count". Nothing is counted when
Check for updates is Never, and Check Now never counts.

More: https://github.com/NikitaUsov/BatteryPulse/blob/main/docs/USER_GUIDE.md#privacy
